description: Balance unequal loads while preserving the reachable exit and reset handle.
Route the marked carriage through three bearings and prove its return path.
Carry bounded heat to all three visible chart-drying stations.
Float, pivot and unload the marked tender cargo using freely resettable safe stops.
Draw two translucent panel hems to the pictured marks, leave the broad sky opening empty, then walk the audience aisle.
Receive heat, manually shelter the wax seam without blocking its vent, release the same cast and walk the cool loading side.
Nudge the print weight from the marked side to its center notch, operate its hand latch and walk along the dry unprinted aisle.
Set the tray shutter, tilt the lens to the painted bearing and walk between its two clear viewing marks.
Reconnect the paired marked pools in the reed-basin side quest.
Press three marked braces while each pedestrian side lane remains open; dragging a baffle into a walking lane invalidates only that attempt.
Draw two counterweights to opposite marked rests until the hanging clapper clears both sides; the player can inspect its entire swing.
Uncap three signposted spring mouths in separate pockets after observing their distinct bubbles; one dry inspection socket must be left closed.
Reveal the feeding current, fill the catch bowl and close two leaks before draining the practice outlet; targets have distinct shapes.
Turn three hood vanes to lift a visible ribbon through upper outlets without blowing on the seedling bed.
As form32, reuse one charged brick to dry clay, temper a tool and warm seedlings in that order, cooling it at a marked sink between uses; prove all three different outputs.
Grow two elevated seed supports after manually opening the airflow hood; carry the marked seed tray by the open upper walkway.
Turn the hood down into a settling basket, open its safe side bypass and return the hood to still; visible ash clears rather than becoming a damage cloud.
Reveal both branch arrows and fill alternating receiving bowls without feeding the already-full trough; no timer or random rain.
Grow roots into two dry hedge ties while a third living opening stays clear; choose the low sheltered plot, not every green target.
Reel the drying line through three marked hooks from different safe approaches while a wide worker passage remains unobstructed.
Tune three mechanically distinct catches after placing sound baffles on their pictogram rests; the source is geometry and vibration cues, not hearing acuity.
As form35, brace the high and low supports from opposite landings and move the central slab between them without blocking the marked return loop.
Store heat from each of three numbered refractory jars, then park each at the matching safe shelf; never warm the seedling tray.
Draw three sample pins out in the diagrammed direction while the protected pot is behind its baffle; each pin has an independent identity.
Complete the fixed three-vane no-projectile-hit wind-loom challenge after Sky clear; retries cost nothing.
Brace the two restoration pillars in one timed trial after Core clear; retries cost nothing.
Restore three distinct damaged root beds; repeated healing never counts.
Light three distinct abandoned hearths once each, then choose to nurture Homura at the sanctuary.
